root_cause: CudagraphDispatcher requires every registered attention-family op in splitting_ops for PIECEWISE mode. Removing only the three Qwen/XPU GDN split points therefore triggered its startup assertion before weight loading.
interpretation: This does not test whether Inductor can retain the state-mutating GDN op. It only proves that a partial attention split list cannot be paired with PIECEWISE mode on this vLLM commit.
corrected_boundary: At the measured c64 shape, capture size 1 is not active. A separate compile-on, cudagraph-NONE candidate may omit the GDN split points without claiming a c64 graph-mode change.
